versions.changelog:
- Updated scripts/web_image_optimizer.py for version 1.1.0.
- No user-facing changes documented in SKILL.md for this version.

- Initial release of Web Image Optimizer.
- Compress images to under 500KB with smart quality reduction and auto-resize.
- Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, and GIF input; outputs WebP by default or JPEG/PNG as needed.
- Includes batch processing with optional recursive scanning of subdirectories.
- Provides configurable options for output format, max file size, and quality.
- Processes images locally with no network usage and strips metadata for smaller file sizes.
